particlemuffler.tip.disable: You can disable these tips in the config
particlemuffler.tip.change_density: Drag the slider of a muffled particle to let some of them through (0% = none, 90% = most)
particlemuffler.tip.inv_button: You can move the inventory button by holding the RMB over it and dragging it around
particlemuffler.tip.inv_button_disable: You can disable the muffler button in your inventory in the config
particlemuffler.tip.preview: Press the play button next to a particle to spawn a few of them around you
particlemuffler.tip.unmuffle: Press the button at the bottom right to stop muffling all particles, press it again to resume
particlemuffler.tip.no_anchors: You can disable the Anchors in the config
particlemuffler.tip.blacklist: You can blacklist particles from the Recent list in the config
particlemuffler.tip.left_buttons: You can move the muffle and preview buttons to the left in the config
particlemuffler.tip.dark_theme: You can enable the dark theme in the config
particlemuffler.tip.use_anchors: Anchors (the 10 numbered buttons) muffle particles only inside an area
particlemuffler.tip.set_anchors: Click a numbered Anchor button, then the marker button on the right to place the Anchor where you stand
particlemuffler.tip.modify_anchors: Once an Anchor is set, click the marker button again to move it to your position
particlemuffler.tip.modify_anchors_2: You can rename an Anchor and change its radius once its position is set
particlemuffler.tip.reset_recent: Hold Shift and click the trash button to clear the Recent list
particlemuffler.tip.everything: Muffle EVERYTHING inside an Anchor to hide every particle in that area
particlemuffler.tip.mods_muffled: You can muffle every particle from a mod at once with "modsMuffled" in the config
